responsibility: Declares the main item-level lowering visitor for Rust HIR. It provides the entry point used to compile or query ordinary items with an optional concrete TyTy instantiation and reference location, and defines the visitor surface for top-level statics, constants, functions, impl blocks, extern blocks, and modules that feed the rest of the backend compilation pipeline.
same_name_distinction: Declares the CompileItem visitor interface and static entry point. Unlike rust-compile-item.cc, it only exposes the item-level lowering API, visitor coverage, and stored compilation state for optional concrete instantiations and reference locations, without implementing the lowering logic.
